Follow this photograph, not a new pose. Crop to head and upper shoulders without arms or hands. Image 2 is approved Jepsen 2.3, STYLE ONLY, never borrow her face, hair, glasses or jewellery. 4:5 vertical museum catalogue pen portrait, head and upper shoulders, whole hair visible with modest ivory margin. Flat warm ivory #f7f6f0 background and near-black #14171a ink. Match the FINAL style reference's fine economical lines: varied 2–3 px outside contour at 1024 px width, lighter on top and heavier on the shadow side, much finer facial lines. Keep the actual broad proportions, apparent age, hairline, eyewear, facial hair and expression. Restrained hatching for tone in hair and clothing only, with black masses where documented. Skin on forehead, cheeks, chin and neck stays open blank ivory: NO stipple, NO hatch shading, NO invented wrinkles. Essential brows, lids, nose and mouth contours must remain. No photographic gradients, decorative texture, frame, words, signature, props or hands. Readable at 84×105 pixels without a thick uniform cartoon outline.
